title: Vessel State Snapshot
description: Periodic snapshot of the twin's current view of the vessel, broadcast to all viewers. The twin core derives this from the telemetry packet stream, applying smoothing, dead reckoning between fixes, and plausibility checks. Viewers should treat this as the authoritative render state; they should not parse raw telemetry.

timestamp_ns.description: UTC nanoseconds since Unix epoch at which this snapshot was generated by the twin.

pose.description: Vessel pose in the world. The twin computes heading from successive position fixes if not provided directly.

heading_deg.description: True heading in degrees, or null when not yet computed.

speed_kn.description: Speed over ground in knots, or null.

channels.description: Latest reading on each active channel, indexed by channel name. Values are the most recent packet's value; the consumer can rely on these being fresh within the last sample period.

bathymetry.description: Progressive bathymetry summary included in every snapshot so new viewers can render the seafloor immediately. The full voxel grid lives in the twin; this object carries a downsampled viewport centered on the vessel.

voxel_count.description: Total voxels accumulated in the twin's full grid. Grows monotonically.

viewport_radius_m.description: Radius of the viewport in meters. The viewer receives only voxels within this radius of the vessel.

cells.description: Downsampled depth cells in the viewport. Each cell is [lat, lon, depth_m, confidence_0_to_1]. The viewer renders these as a colored mesh. Empty array when no depth data yet.
